description: This file contains an immutable class implementation of the AcknowledgementRequest interface, representing an acknowledgment request with a label, including methods for creation, equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest
classes.description: An immutable class implementing the AcknowledgementRequest interface, encapsulating an acknowledgment label with utility methods.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of ImmutableAcknowledgementRequest with a non-null acknowledgment label.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the acknowledgment label associated with this request.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the label.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on the label.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the label.
